artifacts.root_cause: FOUND 2026-09-20T03:05Z. functions/api/gspc.ts excludeOwnLeader() and dropUncardedLeader() returned { ...rest, leader: undefined } — an own property set to undefined. The edge signer's canonical() walks Object.keys and emits it as the literal `"leader":undefined`; JSON.stringify (serving) drops undefined properties. 11 axes carry public_leader_state (EXCLUDED_OWN_MODEL/NO_SIGNED_CARD), so the signed bytes contained 11 occurrences of `"leader":undefined` that the served bytes never carry: no reconstruction of the signed preimage from served bytes is possible. Consistent with all controls: living_stamp verifies because its preimage maps every field through explicit nulls; 214 bounded drop-1/drop-2/nested variants fail because the divergence is an added literal, not a removed field.
